facts.fact: BEAC's register of instructions, circulars and regulations lists CEMAC/UMAC Regulation No. 03 of 21 December 2016 on payment systems, means and incidents as a CEMAC-wide text; Chad is a CEMAC member. Document published date used (2026-09-02) for the register; instrument dated 2016.
facts.system: CEMAC/UMAC Regulation No. 03/CEMAC/UMAC/CM of 2016 on payment systems, means and incidents

facts.fact: BEAC's register lists CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC Regulation No. 04/18 of 21 December 2018 on payment services in the CEMAC, a CEMAC-wide text covering Chad as a member.
facts.system: CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC Regulation No. 04/18 of 2018 on payment services

note: Register lists titles only; the 2014 multibanking instruction and 2018 interoperability instruction are listed by title with no statement that providers must connect, so no connect fact.
